provider.name: Global Names Usage Bank
provider.organization_type: scientific-name usage, nomenclatural act, taxonomic concept, bibliographic reference, agent, identifier, provenance, and biodiversity nomenclature infrastructure
provider.description: The Global Names Usage Bank is a Global Names Architecture project for representing individual usages of scientific names in publications and datasets. It links name strings to references, agents, nomenclatural and taxonomic acts, classifications, statuses, type information, persistent identifiers, source provenance, and related usages.
institutional_context: Biodiversity informatics and nomenclatural data providers
Taxonomic publishers, museums, registries, and research institutions
